summary.zh: 卡片跟着指针倾斜，里面的几层按深度错开移动，影子反向偏移，还有一条反光带扫过。用弹簧插值，松手会带点惯性回正；没人碰的时候自己慢慢画 8 字。
summary.en: The card tilts toward the pointer, inner layers shift by depth, the shadow counter-shifts and a sheen slides across. Spring-interpolated, so it settles with a little inertia; idle, it slowly traces a figure-eight.

technique.zh: rAF 里做弹簧积分：v = (v + (目标 - 当前)×刚度)×阻尼；把结果写进 --px/--py/--rx/--ry 四个 CSS 变量，每层用 translate3d(px×z, py×z) 产生视差。
technique.en: A spring step in rAF: v = (v + (target − x) × k) × damping; results go into --px/--py/--rx/--ry, and each layer uses translate3d(px×z, py×z) for parallax.

adapt.zh: 每一层设一个 --z（负数在后、正数在前）；不想要空闲动画就删掉 tick() 里的李萨如那段。
adapt.en: Give each layer a --z (negative = behind); delete the Lissajous block in tick() to disable the idle motion.
